description: This PHP class defines a pre-transform for the HTMLPurifier library that converts deprecated hspace and vspace attributes on images into CSS styles by applying margin properties.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ImgSpace
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming deprecated image space attributes (hspace and vspace) into CSS margin styles within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the specific attribute ('hspace' or 'vspace') to transform and validates it.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the specified attribute by converting its value into CSS margin styles and prepending these styles to the element's style.
